name: frontend-maintainer
body: A person who builds, releases, or upgrades apg and its language frontends. They must know, before cutting a release, exactly which toolchain versions compile and stage each frontend, so a release is reproducible and an upgrade of a toolchain is a deliberate act rather than drift. Their interest is an explicit per-frontend dependency contract: build-time deps, scan-time deps, and the engine pin that sets the language-version ceiling.
